families.description_terse: Get a weather forecast for a location.

variants.name: get_forecast_hourly
variants.description: Hourly weather forecast for one location covering the next 48 hours, with temperature, precipitation chance and wind per hour.

units.description: Unit system for the forecast values

variants.query: Give me the hourly forecast for Lisbon for the rest of today.
variants.query_implied: I'm cycling in Lisbon this afternoon; how will the rain chance change from one hour to the next?

variants.name: get_forecast_daily
variants.description: Daily weather forecast for one location covering the next 7 days, with high, low and precipitation chance per calendar day.

units.description: Unit system for the forecast values

variants.query: What does the daily forecast look like for Denver over the next week?
variants.query_implied: What will the highs and lows be in Denver for each of the next seven days?

variants.name: get_forecast_weekend
variants.description: Weekend weather forecast for one location covering only the coming Saturday and Sunday, with temperature and precipitation chance per half day.

units.description: Unit system for the forecast values

variants.query: What's the weekend forecast for Porto?
variants.query_implied: Will it rain in Porto this Saturday or Sunday?

variants.name: get_forecast_extended
variants.description: Extended weather forecast for one location covering days 8 to 30 ahead, with temperature and precipitation trend ranges per week.

units.description: Unit system for the forecast values

variants.query: Show me the extended forecast for Calgary for next month.
variants.query_implied: Will Calgary be warmer or colder than normal about three weeks out? I want the forecast trend.

families.description_terse: Get an air quality reading for a location.

variants.name: get_air_ozone_level
variants.description: Current and recent ground level ozone concentration in the air at one location, in parts per billion with a health category.

hours_back.description: How many past hours of readings to include

variants.query: What's the ozone level in Fresno right now?
variants.query_implied: How many parts per billion of ground level O3 are in the air in Fresno right now?

variants.name: get_air_particulate_level
variants.description: Current and recent fine particulate matter readings, PM2.5 and PM10, in the air at one location, with a health category.

hours_back.description: How many past hours of readings to include

variants.query: How bad is the particulate pollution in Krakow at the moment?
variants.query_implied: What are the PM2.5 and PM10 readings in Krakow at the moment?

variants.name: get_air_pollen_level
variants.description: Current pollen counts in the air at one location, broken down by tree, grass and weed sources, with an allergy risk level.

hours_back.description: How many past hours of readings to include

variants.query: Is the pollen count high in Atlanta today?
variants.query_implied: My hay fever is acting up; are the tree and grass counts high in Atlanta today?

variants.name: get_air_smoke_level
variants.description: Current wildfire smoke density in the air at one location from satellite and sensor data, with visibility impact and a health category.

hours_back.description: How many past hours of readings to include

variants.query: Is there wildfire smoke over Boise right now, and how thick is it?
variants.query_implied: Wildfires are burning upwind of Boise; how hazy is the air there right now?

families.description_terse: List active weather warnings for a location.

variants.name: list_flood_alerts
variants.description: List active flood watches and warnings issued for one location, covering river, coastal and flash flooding, with start and end times.
variants.query: Are there any flood warnings in effect for Savannah?
variants.query_implied: Is the river expected to burst its banks in Savannah? Are there official warnings?

variants.name: list_heat_alerts
variants.description: List active extreme heat watches and warnings issued for one location, with peak temperature, heat index and expected duration.
variants.query: Is there a heat warning for Phoenix this week?
variants.query_implied: Are there official warnings about dangerously high temperatures in Phoenix this week?

variants.name: list_storm_alerts
variants.description: List active thunderstorm, hail and damaging gust warnings issued for one location, with expected arrival time and severity.
variants.query: Any storm warnings for Omaha tonight?
variants.query_implied: Should I expect thunder, hail or damaging gusts in Omaha tonight? Check the official warnings.

variants.name: list_frost_alerts
variants.description: List active frost and freeze warnings issued for one location, with the expected overnight low and the hours at risk.
variants.query: Are there frost warnings out for Yakima tonight?
variants.query_implied: Do I need to cover my tomato plants in Yakima tonight? Is there a freeze warning?

families.description_terse: Get past weather measurements for a location.

variants.name: get_observed_rainfall
variants.description: Measured rainfall totals for one location between two past dates, returned per day in millimetres from the nearest weather station.
variants.query: How much rainfall did Leeds get between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-07?
variants.query_implied: How many millimetres of rain fell in Leeds between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-07?

variants.name: get_observed_temperature
variants.description: Measured air temperature highs and lows for one location between two past dates, returned per day from the nearest weather station.
variants.query: What were the temperature highs and lows in Turin from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-20?
variants.query_implied: How hot and how cold did it get in Turin each day from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-20?

variants.name: get_observed_wind
variants.description: Measured wind speed, gusts and prevailing direction for one location between two past dates, returned per day from the nearest weather station.
variants.query: What were the wind speeds in Galway between 2026-02-01 and 2026-02-14?
variants.query_implied: How gusty was it in Galway between 2026-02-01 and 2026-02-14?

variants.name: get_observed_snowfall
variants.description: Measured snowfall and snow depth for one location between two past dates, returned per day in centimetres from the nearest weather station.
variants.query: How much snowfall did Salt Lake City record from 2025-12-20 to 2025-12-31?
variants.query_implied: How many centimetres of snow came down in Salt Lake City from 2025-12-20 to 2025-12-31?

families.description_terse: List invoices on a billing account.

variants.name: list_draft_invoices
variants.description: List draft invoices on one billing account that have been prepared but not yet sent to the customer for payment.
variants.query: Show me the draft invoices on billing account AC-4471 that haven't gone out yet.
variants.query_implied: Which invoices on billing account AC-4471 have I prepared but not sent to the customer yet?

variants.name: list_overdue_invoices
variants.description: List sent invoices on one billing account that remain unpaid after their due date. Draft, paid and voided invoices are excluded.
variants.query: Which invoices on billing account AC-2290 are overdue?
variants.query_implied: Which invoices on billing account AC-2290 are past their due date and still unpaid?

variants.name: list_paid_invoices
variants.description: List invoices on one billing account that have been fully paid, with payment date and method. Unpaid invoices are excluded.
variants.query: List the paid invoices for billing account AC-7015 so I can reconcile them.
variants.query_implied: Which invoices on billing account AC-7015 has the customer settled in full?

variants.name: list_voided_invoices
variants.description: List invoices on one billing account that were voided after issue and no longer count toward the balance due.
variants.query: Pull up the voided invoices for billing account AC-3318.
variants.query_implied: Which invoices on billing account AC-3318 did we cancel after issuing them, so they no longer count toward the balance?

families.description_terse: Refund an amount from a paid invoice.

variants.name: issue_card_refund
variants.description: Refund an amount from a paid invoice back to the payment card originally charged on the billing account. Settles in 5 to 10 business days.

invoice_number.description: Invoice the refund is drawn from

amount.description: Refund amount in the invoice currency

refund_reason.description: Short reason recorded on the refund

variants.query: Refund 40.00 from invoice INV-20931 on billing account AC-4471 back to the customer's card.
variants.query_implied: Refund 40.00 from invoice INV-20931 on billing account AC-4471; the customer swiped at checkout, so reverse it to that same payment method.

variants.name: issue_bank_refund
variants.description: Refund an amount from a paid invoice by bank transfer to the account holder's registered bank account rather than a card.

invoice_number.description: Invoice the refund is drawn from

amount.description: Refund amount in the invoice currency

refund_reason.description: Short reason recorded on the refund

variants.query: Send a 120.00 bank refund for invoice INV-18820 on billing account AC-6620.
variants.query_implied: Wire 120.00 back to the account holder for invoice INV-18820 on billing account AC-6620, to their registered account number.

variants.name: issue_ledger_refund
variants.description: Refund an amount from a paid invoice as a credit entry on the billing account ledger, offset against future invoices. No money is paid out.

invoice_number.description: Invoice the refund is drawn from

amount.description: Refund amount in the invoice currency

refund_reason.description: Short reason recorded on the refund

variants.query: Refund 25.50 from invoice INV-11884 as a ledger credit on billing account AC-5102.
variants.query_implied: Don't pay any money out: keep 25.50 from invoice INV-11884 on billing account AC-5102 as a credit to offset against their future invoices.

variants.name: issue_wallet_refund
variants.description: Refund an amount from a paid invoice to the account holder's linked digital wallet balance, usually available within one hour.

invoice_number.description: Invoice the refund is drawn from

amount.description: Refund amount in the invoice currency

refund_reason.description: Short reason recorded on the refund

variants.query: Refund 15.00 from invoice INV-30417 on billing account AC-2290 to the customer's wallet.
variants.query_implied: The customer wants 15.00 from invoice INV-30417 on billing account AC-2290 returned to their phone payment app balance.

families.description_terse: Look up a tax rate for a jurisdiction.

variants.name: get_sales_tax_rate
variants.description: Look up the combined state and local sales tax rate for a tax jurisdiction and optional product category, as applied to invoice lines at checkout.

product_category.description: Product or service category being invoiced

account_id.description: Billing account whose tax exemptions apply

variants.query: What sales tax rate applies to software in jurisdiction JX-104?
variants.query_implied: What's the combined state and local rate charged at checkout on software in jurisdiction JX-104?

variants.name: get_value_added_tax_rate
variants.description: Look up the value added tax rate for a tax jurisdiction and optional product category, including any reduced rate bands on invoices.

product_category.description: Product or service category being invoiced

account_id.description: Billing account whose tax exemptions apply

variants.query: What's the value added tax rate for printed books in jurisdiction JX-220?
variants.query_implied: Do printed books get a reduced rate band in jurisdiction JX-220, and what's the rate?

variants.name: get_excise_tax_rate
variants.description: Look up the excise duty rate for a tax jurisdiction and product category, for invoiced goods such as fuel, alcohol or tobacco.

product_category.description: Product or service category being invoiced

account_id.description: Billing account whose tax exemptions apply

variants.query: What excise rate applies to fuel in jurisdiction JX-318?
variants.query_implied: What duty do we owe on fuel in jurisdiction JX-318?

variants.name: get_withholding_tax_rate
variants.description: Look up the withholding tax rate that must be deducted from an invoice payment for a tax jurisdiction and service category.

product_category.description: Product or service category being invoiced

account_id.description: Billing account whose tax exemptions apply

variants.query: What withholding tax rate do we deduct for consulting services in jurisdiction JX-415?
variants.query_implied: How much must we hold back from a payment for consulting services in jurisdiction JX-415 and pass to the tax office?

families.description_terse: Schedule a payment reminder for an unpaid invoice.

variants.name: schedule_sms_payment_reminder
variants.description: Schedule a payment reminder for an unpaid invoice, delivered as an SMS text message to the billing account's phone number.

send_date.description: Date to send the reminder, YYYY-MM-DD

variants.query: Schedule an SMS reminder for invoice INV-3302 on billing account AC-4471 for 2026-11-05.
variants.query_implied: Text the billing phone number on billing account AC-4471 a payment reminder for invoice INV-3302 on 2026-11-05.

variants.name: schedule_postal_payment_reminder
variants.description: Schedule a payment reminder for an unpaid invoice, printed and posted as a paper letter to the billing account's mailing address.

send_date.description: Date to send the reminder, YYYY-MM-DD

variants.query: Schedule a postal reminder for invoice INV-2817 on billing account AC-6620 to go out on 2026-11-12.
variants.query_implied: Send a paper reminder letter about invoice INV-2817 on billing account AC-6620 by post on 2026-11-12.

variants.name: schedule_voice_payment_reminder
variants.description: Schedule a payment reminder for an unpaid invoice, delivered as an automated voice call to the billing account's phone number.

send_date.description: Date to send the reminder, YYYY-MM-DD

variants.query: Set up an automated voice reminder for invoice INV-4410 on billing account AC-7015 on 2026-11-20.
variants.query_implied: Have an automated phone call remind billing account AC-7015 about invoice INV-4410 on 2026-11-20.

variants.name: schedule_portal_payment_reminder
variants.description: Schedule a payment reminder for an unpaid invoice, shown as a banner notice inside the account holder's self service billing portal.

send_date.description: Date to send the reminder, YYYY-MM-DD

variants.query: Put a portal reminder about invoice INV-5093 on billing account AC-3318 starting 2026-12-01.
variants.query_implied: Show a banner in the customer's self service billing site reminding billing account AC-3318 about invoice INV-5093 from 2026-12-01.

families.description_terse: Get an employee's remaining leave balance.

variants.name: get_vacation_leave_balance
variants.description: Remaining paid vacation leave days for one employee in the current leave year, including days carried over and days already booked.

as_of_date.description: Balance date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

variants.query: How many vacation days does employee EMP-5521 have left?
variants.query_implied: Employee EMP-5521 is planning a beach trip next summer; how many paid days off for that do they have left?

variants.name: get_sick_leave_balance
variants.description: Remaining paid sick leave days for one employee in the current leave year, after deducting recorded sickness absences.

as_of_date.description: Balance date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

variants.query: How many sick days has employee EMP-3390 got remaining this year?
variants.query_implied: Employee EMP-3390 has the flu again; how many paid days for illness do they have left this year?

variants.name: get_parental_leave_balance
variants.description: Remaining parental leave weeks for one employee under their current entitlement, including weeks scheduled but not yet taken.

as_of_date.description: Balance date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

variants.query: How much parental leave does employee EMP-1184 have left?

variants.name: get_bereavement_leave_balance
variants.description: Remaining bereavement leave days for one employee in the current leave year under the compassionate leave policy.

as_of_date.description: Balance date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

variants.query: How many bereavement days are left for employee EMP-2047?
variants.query_implied: Employee EMP-2047's grandmother passed away; how many compassionate days do they have left?

families.description_terse: Submit a leave request for an employee.

variants.name: submit_full_day_leave
variants.description: Submit a leave request for one complete working day for an employee, deducting a single full day from their leave balance.

hours.description: Hours of leave within the day

variants.query: Book a full day off for employee EMP-5521 on 2026-12-03.
variants.query_implied: Book employee EMP-5521 off work for the whole of 2026-12-03.

variants.name: submit_half_day_leave
variants.description: Submit a leave request for a morning or afternoon on one date for an employee, deducting half a day from their leave balance.

hours.description: Hours of leave within the day

variants.query: Request a half day off for employee EMP-3390 on the afternoon of 2026-11-14.
variants.query_implied: Employee EMP-3390 wants just the afternoon of 2026-11-14 off; please submit it.

variants.name: submit_hourly_leave
variants.description: Submit a leave request for a number of hours within one working day for an employee, deducting only those hours from their balance.

hours.description: Hours of leave within the day

variants.query: Employee EMP-1184 needs 3 hours off on 2026-11-21, please file it as hourly leave.
variants.query_implied: Employee EMP-1184 needs to step out for 3 hours on 2026-11-21; please file that leave.

variants.name: submit_multi_day_leave
variants.description: Submit a leave request covering a continuous range of working days for an employee, from a first day to a last day.

hours.description: Hours of leave within the day

variants.query: File a multi day leave request for employee EMP-2047 from 2026-12-21 to 2026-12-24.

families.description_terse: List an employee's leave requests.

variants.name: list_pending_leave_requests
variants.description: List an employee's leave requests that are still pending manager approval, with requested dates and leave type.
variants.query: Which leave requests from employee EMP-5521 are still pending?
variants.query_implied: Which of employee EMP-5521's leave requests is the manager still sitting on?

variants.description: List an employee's leave requests that a manager has approved, including upcoming dates and leave already taken.

variants.query_implied: Which leave requests for employee EMP-3390 has the manager signed off on?

variants.name: list_rejected_leave_requests
variants.description: List an employee's leave requests that a manager rejected, with the rejection reason recorded for each request.
variants.query: Which of employee EMP-1184's leave requests were rejected this year?
variants.query_implied: Which of employee EMP-1184's leave requests were turned down this year, and why?

variants.name: list_withdrawn_leave_requests
variants.description: List leave requests the employee withdrew themselves, before or after approval, so the days went back to their balance.

variants.query_implied: Which leave requests did employee EMP-2047 retract on their own?

variants.description: List national public holidays one office observes in a given year, when its employees get statutory paid leave.

variants.description: List regional public holidays one office observes in a given year, set by the state or province, when its employees get paid leave.

variants.query_implied: Which public holidays specific to the state or province does office OF-31 observe in 2027?

variants.name: list_company_holidays
variants.description: List extra closure days the employer grants employees at one office in a given year as paid leave, beyond public holidays.

office_code.description: Office code the employee works from

families.description_terse: Quote the price to ship a parcel.

variants.name: quote_same_day_shipping
variants.description: Quote the price for a parcel collected and delivered on the same day within one metro area, by origin postcode, destination postcode and weight.
variants.query: How much would same day delivery cost for a 2 kg parcel from postcode 10115 to 10437?
variants.query_implied: How much to have a 2 kg parcel picked up and delivered across town by this evening, from postcode 10115 to 10437?

variants.name: quote_overnight_shipping
variants.description: Quote the price for a parcel delivered by 10am the next business day, by origin postcode, destination postcode and weight.
variants.query: Quote overnight shipping for a 4.5 kg parcel from postcode 80331 to 20095.
variants.query_implied: What does it cost to get a 4.5 kg parcel from postcode 80331 to 20095 by 10am tomorrow?

variants.name: quote_two_day_shipping
variants.description: Quote the price for a parcel guaranteed to arrive within two business days, by origin postcode, destination postcode and weight.

variants.name: quote_ground_shipping

families.description_terse: Get tracking information for a parcel.

variants.name: get_parcel_latest_scan
variants.description: Track one parcel by tracking number and return only its latest scan event, with location and time. Earlier scan events are omitted.

variants.name: get_parcel_scan_history
variants.description: Track one parcel by tracking number and return its full scan history, every scan event from label creation to now, oldest first.

variants.name: get_parcel_delivery_estimate
variants.description: Track one parcel by tracking number and return its delivery estimate, a predicted date with start and end time, while in transit.

variants.name: get_parcel_proof_of_delivery
variants.description: Track one delivered parcel by tracking number and return its proof of delivery, with signer name, signature image and time signed.
